description: The framework's governance manifest: every tracked file's current version and delivery. Current state only (EVOL-118) — the history of a change lives in its commit and its pull request.
upgrade_strategy: Smart Additive Merge — ALL files use the same unified strategy: format-aware structural diff → add new content only → resolve placeholders in additions → preserve all existing content. No separate Cat A/B/C upgrade paths.

content_types.universal: No placeholders. New structural additions are merged additively.
content_types.stack_configured: Contains {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens. New sections/fields are added, placeholders resolved via Smart Discovery + RDR.
content_types.project_data: Project-specific values. New fields/sections added with defaults, existing values never modified.

agent_templates._description: Per-role agent templates consumed by CODESIGN, BLUEPRINT (architect), DEVELOP, PO, QA, SECURITY, UX, and PEER REVIEW agents at feature time. Synced to materialised projects by factory-sync.sh under the same `.context/templates/{role}/` path. Tracked here so SETUP --upgrade can apply Smart Additive Merge with version awareness instead of factory-sync.sh's blind overwrite. Placeholders ({{FEATURE_ID}}, {{TIMESTAMP}}, etc.) are runtime-resolved by agents when generating per-feature artefacts — they are part of the template contract, not setup-time variables. Hence content_type: universal across the board.
agent_templates._architecture: Each entry's target is the same `.context/templates/{role}/{file}` path in the materialised project. SETUP --upgrade walks this section under Step 2 (Unified Smart Additive Merge) + Step 3 (New File Handling). EVOL-027 fase 1 — keystone for fase 5 (parser-canonical user_journey reaches materialised projects via --upgrade).

Phase 0 Coherence Audit (agentic, semantic) runs BEFORE preflight Phases 1-6 when the diff is governance-sensitive. Phase 0 reads `config/coherence-context.json` (single source of truth for `context: meta|downstream`), extracts changed symbols (renames, deletions, moved identifiers, public artefact names), builds a bounded collateral set via `git grep` against `audit.root_sets` minus `audit.exclusions`, applies six detectors (13 Reference coherence, 14 Placeholder leakage, 15 Manifest↔disk coherence, 16-meta meta↔template lock-step, 16-downstream code↔docs lock-step, 17 Commit↔diff coherence, 18 Bump severity↔change kind), and writes a session+sha-scoped marker `.context/state/coherence-audit-${branch_sha}.marker`. Axis 6 (complexity) runs in Phase 3 when has_code AND config/quality.json present — invokes factory-complexity-check skill on changed source files, emits Block 19 (DC-28 Cyclomatic complexity exceeds project threshold). Hard blocks total: 20. Axis 7 (agentic code review) runs in Phase 3 when has_code — INVOKE_SKILL factory-code-review scope=branch, the ONLY writer of the Block 20 marker .context/state/code-review-${content_hash}.marker; preflight.sh Step 0-bis verifies it (RDR-1 content-hash keying, RDR-2 fail-open infra / fail-closed findings with audited override, RDR-4 gate profile 3 blocking + 1 conditional + 2 advisory). Mode `--preflight` is the push-gate entry point invoked by the PreToolUse Bash hook; mode `--review {PR}` is manual and may publish to the platform with explicit user confirmation. Docs-only fast-lane allowlist matches CLAUDE.md Generation Standards §3 verbatim — every-path-in-allowlist exits 0 silently and skips Phase 0. Project-rule precedence documented in § Project rules and ADR precedence — the push gate consumes `branching.instructions.md`, `security_policy.md`, `testing.md`, `protected-code.md` + `protected-paths.json`, `codebase_inventory.json`, `contract-first-policy.md` + `api-standards.md`, `architecture.md`, `defect-prevention.md`, `coherence-context.json` (Phase 0), and `quality.json` (axis 6). Explicitly does NOT consume `review-policy.md` (BVL/IMPLEMENT increment pass — work critics; separate concern). ADR-driven exemptions via `pr_review_overrides:` frontmatter on ADRs under `docs/project_log/adr/` (project-wide) or `docs/spec/{ID}/adr/` (feature-scoped).

runtime_artefacts._description: Artefacts that materialise WITHOUT a template source file — at SETUP --generate time, or at command time (`born_at`). SETUP synthesises them from operational data (greenfield: empty seed; brownfield: scanned from existing codebase). Tracked here so SETUP --upgrade and CI can validate their PRESENCE in materialised projects without expecting a corresponding template source under `.context/templates/setup/`. Distinct from `templates` (which require source files) and `agent_templates` (which mirror agent-consumed scaffolds).
runtime_artefacts._architecture: Each entry's `target` is the synthesised location in the materialised project. `bootstrap_synthesised: true` flags that disk-coherence checks (factory-pr-review Block 15) skip the source-existence assertion for this entry. Versioning tracks the schema/format of the synthesised artefact, not source content.
